name: attention_full_decode32_cluster_v1
hypothesis: Clustered split-KV for B32 full q_len-1 may use Hopper DSMEM to combine local split outputs and increase key-level parallelism without the global flat partition.
result: All tested cluster variants passed reference. They were 14-24% slower than flat 264 CTAs on both seeds; keep flat reduction for full decode B=32.
change: Compare several per-request cluster grids against the current flat 264-CTA route.
